description: One-line reminder when the research record has a gap (code without a document, a document or note not ingested into the wiki, a note vault not synced). Reads .claude/research-with-ai.conf in the session folder and in each project folder up to three levels below it, checks each project separately, and does nothing without such a file. Also an improvement hook (principle 18): on a correction-like message it adds one line of context reminding to log a general lesson; at the end of a response it reminds once to ask about pending candidates and about publishing piled-up changes. Reads IMPROVE_CANDIDATES / IMPROVE_LOG from the same config or ~/.claude/research-with-ai.conf; does nothing without them.
